dataItem-ml4ojnte.text: In order to get cheaper leaves, I used Yichen's fern and try to assign the opacity map on it. We can use Quickuvshade visulize the texture in Sop Level.

dataItem-ml4olmen.text: Problem-solving

dataItem-ml4opy0j.text: Problem: I started with a grid and used it to replace the original leaves, but I ran into the issue shown in the image. I suspect the repeated pattern is caused by the grid’s UV projection.

dataItem-ml4ow5wz.text: Solution: So I used UV Flatten instead of UV Project, and the result looks good now.

dataItem-ml4qvdlr.text: I also added a keyframe animation to make it look like it’s swaying in the wind.

dataItem-ml4vd2ew.text: After that, I brought it into Unreal and used Component Builder, but it was not successful. I also imported it back into Houdini as a reference, but that was not very successful either.

dataItem-ml4yocg6.text: No matter whether the geometry is static or animated, it still has the same problem.

dataItem-ml4ytrcn.text: I also tried a single leaf without animation, and the result is still not good, even though it looks normal in Houdini.

dataItem-ml4zuxqd.text: Even when I build the grid directly inside the component, it still has a problem when I import it into Unreal.
